notes.title: Dragon Star Varnir™ Will Release A Day Early on October 8!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/d82c28f280533a4d61f5765f5e172f575e4e5833.png

Awaken the Dragon within! Previously it was stated that the Steam® release of Dragon Star Varnir™ will launch on October 9, but now... the epic dragon RPG will be released A DAY EARLY on October 8, with a 20% weeklong launch discount!

Originally released on the PlayStation®4, the Steam version will include ALL gameplay and art content from the Japanese version, as well as English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

Upon launch, Steam users will be able to grab the Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) at a permanent 10% discount. The Deluxe Pack will also have a weeklong 20% discount and includes:​


 Character and Background Art Collection​
 Rough Art Collection​
 PC Wallpaper (x3)​
 Mobile Wallpaper (x6)​
 Soundtrack (12 tracks)


Taking place in a world where witches are cursed to give birth to dragons, one man tasked with hunting them soon finds his own fate intertwined with his former enemies. Fight against dragons in turn-based, midair combat, using tiers, transformations, and more to weaken them and devour their abilities! The fate of three witches is in your hands – will you choose to save them or sacrifice them to gain items and skills? Your decisions will change the course of the game!​

Add Dragon Star Varnir to your wishlist today!

notes.title: 7.09.2019 Build Update - 4k Support
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We have a new build update that will fix 4k issues that players are experiencing:

Update Notes:

 Fixed 4k and 4k Native Resolution 
*Note: In order to allow 4K settings to work properly, Windows 7 users must first access the Properties menu of the EXE file and change the DPI setting to "Application" (please see image below). Afterwards the 4k resolution should work without issue. Non-Windows 7 users will not need to do this. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34695210/3609bbc758ecd0bbe35ec3219acab14372375e80.png

Please let us know if there are any additional problems affecting the game or if there are any additional 4k issues that you are experiencing. 

Thank you for everyone's support!

Best,
Team Iffy

notes.title: 5.20.2019 Build Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The developers have updated the build with a new patch that addresses the issues below:

Update Notes:
- Improved optimization for display modes

For users who are still experieincing issues with 4k resolution, please make the following settings adjustments:
1. Navigate to the game files for Death end re;Quest (steamapps > common > Death end re;Quest)
2. Right-Click on "Application.exe"
3. Select the "Compatibility" tab
4. Select "Change High DPI Settings"
5. Check "Override high DPI scaling behavior"
6. Select "Application"" in the ""Scaling performed by:" dropdown list."

Thank you all for your patience and support. Please let us know if any issues persist!
